class.name: Wwise
class.description: Optional Audiokinetic Wwise SDK bridge. Enable it with [code]module_wwise_enabled=yes wwise_sdk_path=<Wwise SDK path>[/code].

method.name: initialize
method.description: Initializes the Wwise memory manager, stream manager, sound engine, and music engine.

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: Returns whether Wwise has been initialized.

method.name: load_bank
method.description: Loads a generated Wwise [code].bnk[/code] file into memory and returns its bank id.

method.name: post_event
method.description: Posts a Wwise event on a registered game object and returns the playing id.

method.name: register_game_object
method.description: Registers a Wwise game object id.

method.name: render_audio
method.description: Advances Wwise audio processing. Call once per frame after initialization.

method.name: set_default_listener
method.description: Sets the default Wwise listener game object.

method.name: set_rtpc_value
method.description: Sets an RTPC value globally or on a game object.

method.name: stop_all
method.description: Stops all Wwise events, either globally or on the provided game object.

method.name: unload_bank
method.description: Unloads a bank previously returned by [method load_bank].

method.name: unload_bank_path
method.description: Unloads a bank by the path passed to [method load_bank].

method.name: unregister_game_object
method.description: Unregisters a Wwise game object id.
